message: Join us Saturday for our summer sidewalk sale. Up to 40 percent off in participating booths.
Rain date for the flea market is the following Sunday. Check our page by 7am.
Vendor applications for the fall market are open until the 15th.
Bike lane on Guadalupe finally has the flex posts. Small win for commuters.
Final summer market of the season is September 26 at Mueller. I will have the leftover glassware at half price.
Offering a ride to the Mueller market for anyone without a car this Sunday.
Newcomer question: how do I tell veneer from solid wood?
Book club picks for October announced. We are reading a Texas history title and a mystery.
Went to the Georgetown sale this morning. Pretty picked over by 9am.
Planing a cedar board that smells like every childhood summer.
Got called out for a burst pipe at 2am. Neighbors, please know where your main shutoff is.
Autumn refresh: wool throws and flannel bedding arrive this week at the shop.
Selling an Eames-style lounge chair for 220 dollars. Needs new foam.
I have one, DM me. I can drop it off Friday.
A client needs six matching dining chairs, preferably walnut. Anyone have a set?
October vendor lottery opens next week. Application link on our page.
We are hosting a free repair cafe for lamps and small appliances next Saturday.
Cotton napkin bundles, 25 for 30 dollars, while supplies last.
Four years since I sold my first desk from this garage. Thank you for supporting a small shop.
San Marcos river is clear and cold. Tubing this weekend.
A new load of 100-year-old barn wood arrived. Ask about custom mantels and shelving.
Just got in a lot of Belgian linen tea towels from the 1970s. Soft as anything.
Giving away a crib mattress and changing table. Pflugerville pickup this weekend.
Just listed: a pair of mid-century lamp bases, ceramic, 25 dollars each. They need shades only.
Anyone trading Texas pottery out of Dallas? Looking for pieces for a client.
Refinished a Danish sideboard with Tung oil. Looks incredible, photos in the comments.
Closing early Friday for a dentist appointment. Pickups resume Saturday morning.
I have a small pine bookcase I can donate to a teacher. Message me, Tom.
First day of school prep. My classroom looks like a bookstore exploded.
Campus is quiet. Good time to repaint the stairwells.
Back from the Round Top antique fair with a van full of stoneware crocks. Listing starts tomorrow.
Welcome to our newest member, a dealer specializing in 1950s kitchenware.
Does anyone have an extra 10x10 canopy I could borrow for the September 26 market?
I have an eight-chair set in oak, slightly mismatched but cheap. Sending photos.
Next week's calendar: eight sales in Travis County, three with online previews.
Came across this article about estate sale etiquette. Worth a read if you are new to the circuit.
New dealers this month: two lighting specialists and a vintage barware booth. Open daily 11 to 6.
Selling my pop-up display racks, three for 60 dollars.
Reminder to check your water heater anode rod every two years. It saves a lot of money.
Price drop: the Danish-style dining set is now 340 dollars, down from 395. Pickup in Austin only.
Finished a pine bookcase for a customer in Georgetown. Delivering Saturday.
Looking for original Lucite drawer pulls for a 1970s dresser.
Finally finished the Barton Creek greenbelt loop at sunrise. Worth the early alarm.
Three rattan chairs arriving next week from a patio cleanout. Message me if you want first pick.
Cleaned a 1978 pickup that had not seen soap in a decade. Photos in the album.
Personal note: spending the weekend at Lake Travis with the family, no pickups until Monday.
Available: two five-gallon buckets of leftover interior paint, light gray.
Thank you to everyone who donated last weekend. We raised 4,200 dollars for the youth soccer league.
Estate sale listing: Hyde Park bungalow, vintage glassware, books and garden tools. Saturday and Sunday.
This weekend: 12 estate sales in Travis County, including a full mid-century household in Tarrytown. Doors open at 8am Saturday.
Vintage show next month with 30 mid-century dealers. Admission is free.
Anyone going to the Dripping Springs sale this weekend? I can carpool.
Looking for a used bookshelf for my classroom. Can pick up in Round Rock.
Thank you Beth Calloway for the tip on the Cedar Park estate sale. Walked away with six crates of kitchenware.
Anyone want a free washing machine, in working order? Pickup in South Austin.
New running shoes arrived. Training for the Austin Half in February.
Detail shop update: now offering ceramic coating on Saturdays. Booking through the page.
Found a hand-crank ice cream maker for 10 dollars. Never lose hope.
Selling a lot of 1920s sheet music, DFW pickup.
Cleaning day: a gallon of Murphy Oil Soap and two hours later this pine bookcase looks brand new.
Product launch went well. Team lunch at Torchy's.
Auction in Marble Falls Sunday with farm tools, wagons and hand-built shelving.
A reminder to bring your own bags to the market. Plastic is retired for good.
I have 30 moving boxes free to a good home. Pick up in South Austin.
If you are moving soon, label every box on two sides. Future you will say thanks.
Can anyone identify this teak credenza? Maker's stamp says Skovby, 1960s I think.
Teen volunteers painted a mural in the children's section. It is gorgeous.
Slow week, but I finally cleared the back corner of the garage. Counting that as a win.
End of season clearance on outdoor cushions. Pickup at our San Marcos warehouse.
Client loved the thrifted brass sconces so much we bought a second pair.
A friend gifted me a box of antique monogrammed napkins. They are going in the shop.
Mueller Farmers Market is back Sunday with peaches, tamales and a new coffee roaster.
Looking for board games for the library teen night. Any condition is fine.
Donations welcome Tuesday through Saturday. We are especially short on lamps and picture frames this month.
Booth spots open for the fall Mueller market. Vendor fee is 45 dollars.
Listed a vintage brass floor lamp that works perfectly. Rewired it myself last weekend.
Hospital cafeteria added a taco bar. Morale is high.
Trying a new Thai place on Burnet Road. The green curry was excellent.
Spent the day appraising a collection of Texas pottery. Some real finds in there.
Back to teaching fractions with pizza. It works every time.
Offering free pothos cuttings to anyone who wants them.
Reading this guide on photographing furniture for resale. The tip about shooting in open shade is a real help.
Does anyone know a good upholsterer in San Marcos? Need two dining chairs redone.
Estate sale in Lakeway Friday and Saturday. Full dining set, patio furniture and a gun safe.
A reminder that Marketplace pickups at my place run Tuesday to Saturday, 10am to 6pm. Please message before you drive over.
Vendor applications for the November flea close October 10.
Free tip: a drain snake costs twenty dollars and can save a plumber call.
I charge 40 for within ten miles and 65 out to Round Rock. Stairs are 15 extra.
If you are clearing out a house in Round Rock or Georgetown this month, send me a message. I pay fairly and haul everything.
Estate sale in Cedar Park next Friday, a complete kitchen and a workshop of tools. Details in the comments.
Night shift survival kit: good socks, a thermos and an audiobook.
Rode the new MetroRapid line downtown. Twelve minutes faster than driving, honestly.
Parent night went well. I think I convinced three families to join the science fair.
Restored a 1960s teak nightstand today. Before and after photos are in the album.
Weather looks rough for Saturday. Anyone know the rain policy at Chicon?
We are at the Dripping Springs farmers market Saturday with small shelves and cutting boards.
First Saturday flea market this weekend. 80 vendors, live music, free parking on Chicon.
Tip: arrive before the sign-in sheet opens and bring your own tape measure.
Tip for sellers: clean glassware with white vinegar and it sparkles like new.
Moved three apartments this weekend and found out I now own more bubble wrap than a person should.
Heat advisory in Austin, so loading the van before 8am from now on. Iced coffee is a business expense.
Reading about Austin's new rail plan. Curious to see how the route ends up.
Estate sale alert: Westlake home with Persian rugs, a baby grand piano and teak outdoor furniture.
Quick tip: wash the car in the shade or the soap dries too fast.
New in the garage: a set of eight Fiestaware dinner plates in turquoise, no chips. Listed at 48 dollars.
Weekend special: free delivery in Travis County on any table order over 800 dollars.
Styled a bright kitchen with reclaimed shelving today. Texas pine is underrated.
Does anyone have a source for hardware like old drawer pulls? I'm restoring a rolltop desk.

Surplus hotel towels back in stock, plus 200 cotton tablecloths in assorted colors.
Linen lot sale on Saturday in Hyde Park. Bring cash and a bag.
Sold the walnut sideboard to a lovely couple in Cedar Park. Thank you to everyone who asked about it.
Facebook Marketplace shipping fees changed again. Has anyone switched to local-only?
Built a new farmhouse table from reclaimed pecan. Taking custom orders again.
Does anyone know a reliable restorer for oak ice boxes?
Booth 14 at East Side Flea on the first Saturday of July. Come say hi, I will have mugs, linens and lamps under 20 dollars.
Offering free hauling for any lots over 500 pounds this month. Message me.

Three trucks, six movers, one very large sectional. Everything fit.
Moving sale, dining table plus six chairs, 300 dollars firm. San Marcos pickup.
Need quick advice on card readers for the market. Square or something else?

Pop-up at the Domain this Saturday with vintage table linens and napkin sets.
That looks like a Skovby to me too. Check the underside of the top drawer for a number.
Pro tip: bring zip ties and clamps. Wind at outdoor markets is no joke.
